steps.note: S1.3.1.1 states the net target change (JV+RG)x independent of the initial scratch contents, and S1.3.1's motivation says the schedule subtracts the old scratch contribution and finally restores the scratch values, matching lines 744-750.

S1.3.1.2 gives the bit-case central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, nonzero only for the self pair and intersection one, with the side injection cancelling exactly the intersection-one cases and intersections zero and two already zero.

S1.3.1.3 gives the complex central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2 with its values at each intersection size and states that the side injection cancels the intersection-zero and two cases, as in lines 756-758.
S1.3.2 states forward, inverse, forward invocations sending (x,y) to (x,y+x), (-y,y+x), (-y,x), each restoring its own scratch wires, exactly as lines 761-764.

S1.5.5 says every edge joins comparable nondegenerate labels and S1.5.5.1-16 reproduce every row of the residual table with the correct residuals and dimensions (lines 1024-1041), obtained by splitting A=B perp P and F=<t> perp t^perp (lines 1059-1060).

S1.5.5.14 gives the side edge 2->5 residual P tensor <t_X,t_Y>^perp of dimension h-2 and grounds it in t_X perp t_Y for neighbouring triples, a faithful paraphrase of the inclusion <t_X> in t_Y^perp and its complement at lines 1048-1058.

The plan states that center 3->4 is the only decreasing edge, losing h (S1.5.5.10, S1.5.5.17), sources N and sinks Wm-N (S1.5.2), signed telescoping to Wm-2N, and absolute Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich (S1.5.5.18), matching lines 1061-1071.

S2.1.1 states that orthogonal binary vectors have even support intersection, so weight is additive mod 4 and q_V-q_U = sum wt(v)[v.x] over an orthonormal residual basis, as at lines 1232-1245.
S2.1.2 states the odd weight, the phase i^{eps[v.x]} written as (1+i^eps)/2+(1-i^eps)/2 (-1)^{v.x}, and its conversion by Hadamard conjugation into aI+bX_v or its inverse, matching lines 1246-1257.

The plan states that each edge is a product of one translation kernel per residual basis vector (S2.1, S1.5.9), that each basis vector gives one child call on all f axes (S2.1.6), and that this gives s_c such calls in total (S2.1.7), the k-column tensoring of lines 1262-1271.

summary: P02 states 25 of the 26 sub-steps with their defining content. Bank exchange, label residual budget, rank saving, matrix shear and simultaneous layer are complete, and the complex phase interface has 3 of 4. The one absent sub-step is P4: S2.1.3 names the source and sink corrections and the identity C=iZC^{-1}Z, but it does not give the endpoint frames (I, C^{tensor m}), the C^{-1} carried on the X_a->Y_a pair, or the Z_{a,k} and i^{27k}Z_{a,k} repair.
